hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Inactive Frontage
hazards.description: Roll-down security gates and boarded windows reduce natural surveillance and 'eyes on the street', which can impact pedestrian security.
hazards.location_in_image: Ground floor and upper floors of the building facade

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Buffer
hazards.description: There is no dedicated buffer zone (like a planting strip or furniture zone) between the sidewalk and the roadway, leaving pedestrians close to moving traffic when parking is empty.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk adjacent to the street

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the pedestrian crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection and crosswalk limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the foreground

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A large SUV parked at the curb significantly blocks the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and any oncoming traffic in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrowing the driveway entrance to the minimum necessary width would reduce the pedestrian exposure area and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer and Landscaping
interventions.description: Installing a planting strip or bollards between the sidewalk and the parking lot would clearly define the pedestrian realm and prevent vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Painting the sidewalk path across the driveway would reinforce pedestrian priority and alert drivers to the crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: On-Street Parking or Bike Lane
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for on-street parking or a protected bike lane to narrow the travel lanes and increase separation.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees on the right side to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If there is high pedestrian demand, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and lighting.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or raised crossings to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with street trees to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting to improve visibility and safety, particularly along the stretch with blank frontage.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Street Furniture/Buffer
interventions.description: Install planters or benches to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage the installation of windows, murals, or vertical gardens on blank walls to improve the pedestrian experience and natural surveillance.

interventions.title: Speed Limit Reduction
interventions.description: Reduce the posted speed limit from 30 mph to 20 or 25 mph to better align with the dense, mixed-use urban environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point for transit users near the bus stop.

interventions.title: Streetscape Enhancements
interventions.description: Introduce street trees, planters, or pedestrian-scale lighting to improve the environment and encourage pedestrian activity.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Incentives
interventions.description: Encourage the rehabilitation of the building facade to include transparent windows and active ground-floor uses to improve social safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using thermoplastic high-visibility patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furnishings
interventions.description: Install street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters along the curb to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also improving the aesthetic environment.
